, in human-AI collaboration, the human’s confidence in the AI system is a critical component of the team’s performance, and that we need to develop algorithms that take into account the compatibility of AI updates with prior user experience.

The main takeaway from our work is that
AI systems deployed in teams should be designed to produce compatible updates, and that this can be achieved without sacrificing performance.
human-AI team performance can be improved by considering both the predictive performance of the AI and its compatibility with the user’s experience.
human-AI teams can benefit from a better understanding of the compatibility of AI updates with the user’s experience.
